blocks.text: What you get for {{price.monthly}} a month

blocks.html: A Blocked Account (Sperrkonto) holds the money you will live on in Germany and proves to the authorities that it exists. Without it, most applicants from outside the EU cannot get a visa.

items.html: Deposits in Pakistani rupees at transparent rates

blocks.html: Choose comprehensive cover from established German insurers. The bundle is accepted for your visa application, matched to your age and purpose of stay, and stays with you for your whole time in Germany.

items.html: Travel health insurance for the first weeks after arrival
Public or private health insurance, depending on your status

blocks.html: Pay rent, receive money and keep an eye on your spending in one app. The account is linked to your Blocked Account, has no fees and no minimum balance, and is made for people who have just arrived. You will not need a second German account.

items.html: Opened before you have a residence permit.
Digital debit card that works worldwide, with Apple Pay and Google Pay.
Deposits protected up to €100,000 under the European deposit guarantee scheme.

blocks.html: The monthly fee covers the Blocked Account and the German Bank Account; there is no set-up fee. Your health insurance premium depends on your age and situation and is shown during the application.

We choose partners for one reason: they are good at serving people who have just arrived in Germany. The accounts are held by a licensed partner bank in the EU, deposits from abroad run through an international payments provider, and cover comes from statutory and private health insurers that specialise in international customers.
Our insurance partners are established German insurers with English-speaking service and apps that work in English. Details are available on request.

blocks.text: "Health insurance was the part I was most nervous about. Having it sorted together with the Blocked Account, in one place and in English, took a lot of stress out of the visa appointment."
blocks.author: Lucas F.

items.a: The {{product}} is everything a German visa application requires, set up together in one application: a Blocked Account, health insurance and a German Bank Account. The monthly fee covers the two accounts; the insurance premium goes to the insurer and is billed only after you arrive.
{{price.monthly}} per month and no set-up fee. Your health insurance premium is calculated separately from your age and situation and shown to you during the application.

items.q: Can I deposit more than the required amount?
items.a:
Yes. You can deposit up to €25,000 into your Blocked Account.

Note: anything above the official blocked amount is paid out to you in full with your first monthly payout after activation.
